mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, directly increasing present value of future earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants adjust valuation models.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal collapsing consumer demand, forcing equity valuations to adjust downward as revenue growth expectations deteriorate, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), reduced consumer spending power directly lowers corporate revenue growth expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as recession fears accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate expanding consumer confidence and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as market participants price in sustained expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruption, reducing corporate profitability expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 < 1.5% annualized) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) creates stagflationary pressure that erodes corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as market pricing shifts.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 1.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Extreme labor market tightness (PAYEMS > 160000) accelerates inflation expectations, prompting aggressive Fed rate hikes that depress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 160000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
